content.text:
Recommended interaction is one URL-backed period selector with three visible choices, “Historical”, “This parliamentary term”, and “This year”. Place it below the rankings heading and before the board. On entity pages place it after identity metadata, above the selected total and existing Summary/History navigation. Keep the category wheel and view navigation independent.

Current evidence and implications:

- Rankings have no period selection. They display “Total declared during this parliament”, fetch `/rankings` without parameters, and hold category selection only in local state. See `frontend/src/routes/rankings/+page.svelte:11`, `:24`, and `frontend/src/lib/server/rankings.ts:81`.
- MP/funder headers already display three totals, including current year. `DeclaredTotals.svelte:24` reads all three backend fields, typed in `frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:65`. A selected-period presentation can display the corresponding backend total. Do not calculate a replacement from displayed categories or history.
- A coherent page-wide period must also scope MP categories and funder lists, funder party charts and recipient lists, declaration history, and scope-sensitive counts. These presently consume full detail data. MP sources iterate every declaration in `frontend/src/lib/member-summary.ts:29`; categories come from server aggregates at `:78`; funder charts and recipients use aggregates at `frontend/src/FunderSummary.svelte:17`.
- Keep identity metadata stable. The latest party, constituency, recorded names, and company number should not change with period. Funder `entryCount` currently sits in identity metadata at `frontend/src/FunderIdentity.svelte:19`; move that count into scoped content or make its scope explicit.
- The existing three totals are comparative context. Replacing them with one selected total is a product choice, not a technical requirement. My recommendation is one selected total to prevent a filter that appears to control some numbers but leaves adjacent numbers unchanged. Backend mandatory total fields remain available.

Use `period=historical|term|year` as canonical URL state. My proposed default is `term` across these surfaces. Preserve period when changing ranking category, moving between Summary/History, following ranked entities, and following MP/funder relationships. Encode ranking category as a separate parameter so Back and share links restore both selections. No local-storage preference.

Important routing trap: entity navigation passes `page.url.searchParams`, but `memberHref` and `funderHref` retain only `q` through `searchQueryString`. New period state would currently disappear. See `frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:151`, `:204`, and `frontend/src/lib/search-query.ts:1`. Rankings links also omit all query context at `frontend/src/lib/rankings.ts:87`. Parse period in server loads and return a typed selected period, server-resolved boundaries, and calendar year. Existing detail loading is server-side at `frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:22`; rankings loading is separately server-side at `frontend/src/routes/rankings/+page.server.ts:1`.

Existing history date controls are duplicated, local, and unshareable in `frontend/src/MemberHistory.svelte:6` and `frontend/src/FunderHistory.svelte:6`. Preserve custom date capability as history-only refinement within the selected period, with its URL `from`/`to` state cleared when period changes and pagination reset. This avoids a fourth global period choice. Never silently display stale date restrictions after selecting a preset. The existing filters use inclusive registration dates and exclude undated declarations when bounded at `MemberHistory.svelte:14`. Their current “All … stored declarations” text at `:42` must become period-aware.

Reuse existing `Metric`, `Field`, `Button`, `Notice`, `RankingList`, and Summary/History `ViewLinks`. There is no documented segmented control or select component. Extend the design system with a compact navigation variant of `ViewLinks`, or a small `FilterLinks` presentation component accepting caller-provided labels, destinations, and current state. Prefer native links because selections navigate to server-rendered URLs. Use `aria-current`, neutral actions/focus, wrap long labels on narrow screens, and keep URLs/domain rules outside shared UI. These boundaries follow `frontend/src/lib/ui/README.md:5`, `:26`, `:34` and the native identity navigation composition in `frontend/src/lib/ui/COMPOSITION.md:77`. Document, export, gallery-test any reusable extension.

The global selected-period design requires backend-scoped aggregates, not just frontend filtering. Preserve registration-based inclusion, unknown categories, exact decimal strings, currency/incompleteness rules, declaration versus entry counts, null versus zero, and historical-only undated records. Resolve “this year” on the server using the existing `calendarYear` contract, not the browser clock. Keep visible copy limited to the three controls, existing financial labels, and necessary errors/empty states.

Files read also include `EntityDetails.svelte`, `MemberIdentity.svelte`, `MemberSummary.svelte`, `FunderHistory.svelte`, `lib/server/entity-details.ts`, `lib/ui/IdentityHeader.svelte`, `lib/ui/ViewLinks.svelte`, `lib/ui/ViewLink.svelte`, `lib/ui/index.ts`, the requested poteto skill, and explorer prompt. No files changed.
